% Pattern: theorem/newenvironment/article. Environments that number
% themselves: each sets its counter to the equations, steps the equations
% and steps its counter, so the items and the equations share one sequence.
% A heading environment that is not theorem-like steps them too, and a
% command of the paper sets the equations back to 0.
% seen in the gold pilot (set X)
% want lem-1 statement/lemma 1.1
% want rem-1 remark 1.4
% want lem-2 statement/lemma 2.1
\documentclass{article}
\newcounter{item}
\renewcommand{\theitem}{\arabic{section}.\arabic{item}}
\renewcommand{\theequation}{\thesection.\arabic{equation}}
\newcommand{\cc}{\setcounter{equation}{0}}
\newenvironment{lem}{
\setcounter{item}{\value{equation}} \addtocounter{equation}{1}
\refstepcounter{item}
\par {\bf \theitem.\hspace{1em}Lemma.} \sl }
{\par}
\newenvironment{rem}{
\setcounter{item}{\value{equation}}\addtocounter{equation}{1}
\refstepcounter{item}
\par {\bf \theitem.\hspace{1em}Remark.} }
{\par}
\newenvironment{nonsec}{\bf
\setcounter{item}{\value{equation}}\addtocounter{equation}{1}
\refstepcounter{item}
\par \theitem.\hspace{1em}\ignorespaces }
{\unskip .\ \ \ }
\begin{document}
\section{One}
\begin{lem} Each tree is a graph. \end{lem}
\begin{nonsec}{Trees}\end{nonsec}
\begin{equation} a = a \end{equation}
\begin{rem} The converse fails. \end{rem}
\section{Two}
\cc
\begin{lem} Each path is a tree. \end{lem}
\end{document}
